LABEL: anterior interosseous lymphatic channel
Definition: A lymphatic vessel that drains lymph from the anterior compartment of the forearm and courses alongside the anterior interosseous artery and nerve between the radius and ulna.

LABEL: anterior lymph trunk of accompanying suprarenal vein
Definition: A lymphatic collecting trunk that drains lymph from structures adjacent to the suprarenal vein and conveys it toward regional lymph nodes.

LABEL: circumflex lymphatic channel
Definition: A lymphatic vessel that follows a curved or circular course around an anatomical structure, facilitating lymph drainage from surrounding tissues.

LABEL: collecting lymph trunk of lymphatics of soft parts covering posterior thoracic wall
Definition: A lymphatic collecting trunk that receives lymph from the superficial and deep soft tissues overlying the posterior thoracic wall, including skin, subcutaneous tissue, and muscles.

LABEL: deep radial lymphatic channel
Definition: A lymphatic vessel that courses deep along the radial artery in the forearm, draining lymph from the radial aspect of the forearm and hand toward regional lymph nodes in the upper limb.

LABEL: deep ulnar lymphatic channel
Definition: A lymphatic vessel that accompanies the deep ulnar artery and drains lymph from structures in the ulnar aspect of the forearm.

LABEL: efferent lymphatics from fifth or sixth lowermost intercostal spaces
Definition: A lymphatic vessel that drains lymph from the fifth or sixth lowermost intercostal spaces, typically conveying it toward the thoracic duct for systemic circulation.

LABEL: efferent lymphatics from third, fourth, and fifth intercostal spaces
Definition: A lymphatic vessel that drains lymph from the third, fourth, and fifth intercostal spaces, typically conveying it toward the thoracic duct or associated lymph nodes.

LABEL: epitrochlear lymph node
Definition: A lymph node located in the epitrochlear region, situated in the superficial fascia above the medial epicondyle of the humerus, approximately 3-4 cm proximal to the elbow joint. It receives lymph from the ulnar side of the forearm and hand and drains to the axillary lymph nodes.

LABEL: index finger lateral lymphatic channel
Definition: A lymphatic vessel that is located on the lateral aspect of the index finger and drains lymph from the lateral side of the digit toward the dorsal lymphatic network of the hand.

LABEL: index finger medial lymphatic channel
Definition: A lymphatic vessel that is located on the medial aspect of the index finger and drains lymph from the medial side of the digit toward the dorsal lymphatic network of the hand.

LABEL: lateral lymphatic pathway of upper arm
Definition: A lymphatic vessel that is located along the lateral aspect of the upper arm which provides superficial lymphatic drainage, bypassing the axilla to drain to the deltopectoral, clavicular, and cervical lymph nodes.

LABEL: left anterior mediastinal lymph node
Definition: A lymph node located in the superior mediastinum on the left side, collecting lymph from mediastinal structures including portions of the pericardium and left side of the heart.

LABEL: left collecting lymph trunk of lymphatics of ovary
Definition: A lymphatic collecting trunk that drains lymph from the left ovary, typically ascending along the ovarian vessels toward the left lateral aortic lymph nodes.

LABEL: left lateral aortic lymph node
Definition: A lymph node of the paraaortic group positioned on the left lateral aspect of the abdominal aorta, typically between the renal vessels and the aortic bifurcation. These nodes receive lymph from pelvic organs, kidneys, gonads, and inferior mesenteric drainage areas.

LABEL: lymph node of superior lymphatic collecting vessel of left lung
Definition: A lymph node located in the mediastinum near the bronchi of the left lung that receives lymph from the superior lymphatic collecting vessels of the left lung and drains to the anterior mediastinal lymph nodes.

LABEL: little finger lateral lymphatic channel
Definition: A lymphatic vessel that drains the lateral (radial) border of the little finger, which collects interstitial fluid from the lateral digital skin and subcutaneous tissue and conveys it to the dorsal lymphatic plexus of the hand.

LABEL: little finger medial lymphatic channel
Definition: A lymphatic vessel that drains the medial (ulnar) border of the little finger, which collects interstitial fluid from the medial digital skin and subcutaneous tissue and conveys it to the palmar or dorsal lymphatic plexus of the hand.

LABEL: lymphatics of great omentum
Definition: A lymphatic vessel that is part of the greater omentum and drains lymph from the omental tissue to regional lymph nodes.

LABEL: medial lymph trunk of principal axillary lymph vessel
Definition: A lymphatic collecting trunk that represents the medial pathway within the principal axillary lymphatic drainage system, conveying lymph from the upper limb and thoracic wall toward the central axillary lymph nodes.

LABEL: medial lymphatic pathway of upper arm
Definition: A lymphatic drainage route following the medial aspect of the upper arm, typically accompanying the basilic vein and conveying lymph from the medial forearm and hand toward the axillary lymph nodes.

LABEL: middle finger lateral lymphatic channel
Definition: A lymphatic vessel that is located on the lateral aspect of the middle finger and drains lymph from the lateral side of the digit toward the dorsal lymphatic network of the hand.

LABEL: middle finger medial lymphatic channel
Definition: A lymphatic vessel that drains the medial (ulnar) border of the middle finger, which collects interstitial fluid from the medial digital skin and subcutaneous tissue and conveys it to the palmar or dorsal lymphatic plexus of the hand.

LABEL: lymphatic capillary of palmar arch
Definition: A lymphatic capillary that drains lymph from the palmar region of the hand, running in association with the superficial palmar arterial arch.

LABEL: posterior extrathoracic lymph node
Definition: A lymph node positioned in the posterior extrathoracic region, likely receiving lymph from posterior thoracic wall structures and draining toward mediastinal or axillary lymph node groups.

LABEL: posterior interosseous lymphatic channel
Definition: A lymphatic vessel that drains lymph from the posterior compartment of the forearm and courses alongside the posterior interosseous artery between the radius and ulna.

LABEL: radial lymphatic vessel
Definition: A lymphatic vessel that drains lymph from the radial (lateral) aspect of the forearm and upper limb, running along the superficial lymphatic pathways on the radial side of the upper extremity.

LABEL: retropectoral lymph node
Definition: A lymph node located in the retropectoral space, deep to the pectoralis major muscle and receiving lymph from the breast and anterior thoracic wall structures.

LABEL: right anterior mediastinal lymph node
Definition: A lymph node located in the anterior mediastinum on the right side, positioned anterior to the heart and great vessels. These nodes receive lymph from thymus, pericardium, and anterior thoracic structures.

LABEL: right collecting lymph trunk of lymphatics of testicle
Definition: A lymphatic collecting trunk that drains lymph from the right testis, ascending along the testicular vessels toward the right lateral aortic and pre-aortic lymph nodes at the level of the renal vessels.

LABEL: right lateral aortic lymph node
Definition: A lymph node of the paraaortic group positioned on the right lateral aspect of the abdominal aorta, typically between the renal vessels and the aortic bifurcation. These nodes receive lymph from pelvic organs, kidneys, gonads, and drainage from the inferior vena cava region.

LABEL: ring finger lateral lymphatic channel
Definition: A lymphatic vessel that drains the lateral (radial) border of the ring finger, which collects interstitial fluid from the lateral digital skin and subcutaneous tissue and conveys it to the dorsal lymphatic plexus of the hand.

LABEL: ring finger medial lymphatic channel
Definition: A lymphatic vessel that drains the medial (ulnar) border of the ring finger, which collects interstitial fluid from the medial digital skin and subcutaneous tissue and conveys it to the palmar or dorsal lymphatic plexus of the hand.

LABEL: subclavicular lymph node
Definition: A lymph node located in the subclavicular region, beneath or adjacent to the clavicle, representing either a deep infraclavicular node or a component of the apical axillary group. These nodes receive lymph from upper limb and thoracic wall structures.

LABEL: superficial ulnar lymphatic channel
Definition: A lymphatic vessel that courses superficially along the ulnar (medial) aspect of the forearm, collecting lymph from the medial forearm and ulnar side of the hand, and draining toward the epitrochlear or cubital lymph nodes at the elbow.

LABEL: superior ulnar lymph node
Definition: A lymph node positioned along the superior aspect of the ulnar vessels in the forearm or proximal arm, receiving lymph from the ulnar side of the hand and forearm.

LABEL: suprascapular lymphatic channel
Definition: A lymphatic vessel that drains lymph from the suprascapular region, passing near or through the suprascapular foramen and contributing to lymphatic drainage of the shoulder and upper posterior thorax.

LABEL: thumb lateral lymphatic channel
Definition: A lymphatic vessel that is located on the lateral aspect of the thumb and drains lymph from the lateral side of the digit toward the dorsal lymphatic network of the hand.

LABEL: thumb medial lymphatic channel
Definition: A lymphatic vessel that is located on the medial aspect of the thumb and drains lymph from the medial side of the digit toward the dorsal lymphatic network of the hand.

LABEL: transpectoral lymph vessel
Definition: A lymphatic vessel that traverses through the pectoralis major muscle, facilitating lymph drainage from the breast parenchyma and anterior thoracic wall toward the axillary lymph nodes.

LABEL: transverse cervical lymph node
Definition: A cervical lymph node located along or near the transverse cervical artery in the lateral neck region, receiving lymphatic drainage from adjacent cervical structures.
